HOST.description: The plant host organism affected by a disease or pathogen.

PATHOGEN.description: The causal biological agent (fungus, oomycete, bacterium or virus).

DISEASE.description: The named disease concept linking a host and a pathogen.

GENE_OR_PROTEIN.description: A gene, protein, or resistance locus referenced by a record.

RESISTANCE_FACTOR.description: A characterized or predicted resistance gene/locus conferring reduced disease susceptibility.

DATA_TYPE.description: The category of data a record represents (image dataset, interaction record, genome, expression data, etc).

GEOGRAPHIC_REGION.description: The geographic scope of the underlying data or sampled material.

SOURCE_DATABASE.description: The external database or resource a record was integrated from.

EVIDENCE_TYPE.description: The kind of evidence underlying a record (experimental curation, computational prediction, image annotation, etc).
